scripts.build: next build && rm -rf dist/client dist/server && mkdir -p dist/client dist/server dist/.openai && cp -R out/. dist/client/ && cp platform/server-entry.js dist/server/index.js && cp platform/api-core.js platform/bounded-io.js platform/openapi.js platform/river-source.js platform/sky-source.js platform/live-normalize.js platform/weather-stations.js dist/server/ && cp .openai/hosting.json dist/.openai/hosting.json && node scripts/write-build-provenance.mjs dist/client/build-provenance.json && node scripts/write-csp-headers.mjs dist/client && rm -f dist/client/data/transit-destinations.json
scripts.test:e2e:performance: PLAYWRIGHT_PERFORMANCE=1 playwright test tests/map-product.spec.ts --project=desktop --grep '1,200 movement positions'
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check:release && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.api.toml
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:api: npm run check:release && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.api.toml
